problem_statement: Fix evaluate_rule() so it evaluates a recursive Boolean rule against a JSON fact map. Every valid rule object has exactly one operator: {fact: name} is true only when the named fact is present and its value is truthy, with a missing fact false; {all: rules} requires every child and is true for an empty list; {any: rules} requires at least one child and is false for an empty list; and {not: rule} negates its child. Operators may nest arbitrarily within the bounded input, fact values may be any JSON value, and child order must not change the result.
